messages:
Alex B: Heads-up — Lattice on-prem deploy window tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC (maintenance lane). Customer: Acadia. Brief plan below, need confirmations.

Nina C: I'm booked until 02:15 UTC, can join smoke after that. I'll take infra rollback if needed.

Samir: I can be primary for the rollout steps + can run canary traffic at 02:30.

Maria (SRE): Thx. Please ensure DB migrations are run in read-only mode. Rollback plan: revert k8s image tags + restore DB replica from pre-migration snapshot (snapshot id: snap-2026-03-01-01).

Alex B: Ops notes:
- Start: 02:00 UTC
- Cutover traffic: 02:30 UTC
- Smoke window: 02:30–02:45 UTC
- Full validation: 02:45–03:15 UTC

Alex B: Quick checklist — add reactions when done:
• config pushed to customer repo
• infra tags updated
• smoke script exists
• rollback verified

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @Alex B for 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z. CI: pass, staging snapshot: v2026.03.17

Samir: smoke script (local):
```
# run from controlbox
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://acadia.internal/api/health | jq .status
./smoke-checks/run_all.sh --target=staging
```

Nina C: I've reviewed the migration PR — one comment left on the retry backoff, will push a fix by EOD.

Maria (SRE): I'll pre-warm the caches at 01:50 UTC and monitor latency dashboards. Pager duty: @Maria (SRE) primary, @Samir fallback.

Alex B: Who can own rollback steps if migration fails? Nina? (thanks)

Nina C: I can own rollback. I'll be on standby with a checklist and will coordinate DB snapshot restore if needed.

Samir: I'll watch the canary and post results in this thread. If latency > 200ms for 3 minutes, we rollback.

Alex B: Perfect. I'll update the runbook and post the link.

Alex B: runbook: https://redwood-internal/internal/runbooks/lattice-onprem-cutover (bookmark)

Maria (SRE): copying the on-call checkmarks:
- [x] backups verified
- [ ] monitoring alerts muted for routine noise (will do at 01:55 UTC)

deploy-bot: Reminder — deploy in 1h 10m.

Samir: ack. See you all in the window — ping here when you start.
